description.narrative: SAYP är ett utbildningsprogram som riktar sig till yngre tjänstemän i offentlig sektor samt unga ledare i det civisla samhället. Programmet fokuserar på god samhällsstyrning och deltagarna ges möjlighet att välja olika tematiska inriktningar inom området god samhällsstyrning.

Swedish Institute Academy for Young Professionals (SAYP) Western Balkans is a training programme developed to build awareness, capacity and resilience in the practice of governance. It focuses on building new networks, knowledge and practices for increased transparency, efficiency and resilience in public administration. SAYP is a collaboration between the Swedish Institute (SI) and Swedish universities, responsible for developing and organising training modules. Participants include citizens of and currently working in one of the following countries: Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia. For more information please visit SI's website: https://si.se/en/apply/leadership-programmes/si-summer-academy-for-young-professionals-sayp-western-balkans/
